summary.text: Through Branches and Leaves is a move Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable names for Duke Long in a bamboo forest. When Duke Long wakes, the silver chains binding him have become bamboo leaves.

claims.text: On the walls of Heaven Overseeing Tower a bamboo forest painting appears, a concealment Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable left three hundred thousand years ago. Winds and falling jade leaves reach Duke Long’s heart. He lies among thick jade bamboos, then stands as his limbs take on the strength of grass and trees. In a daze he sees Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable as a young man in green clothes and a white headband. The venerable walks past him and into the bamboo forest, leaving the name of the move. Duke Long wakes already standing. The silver chains that bound him have turned into bamboo leaves scattered on the ground, looking as if they were made from jade.

Duke Long takes this as a Genesis Lotus true inheritance. His wood path attainment rises to an extremely high level, and memories of this wood path killer move are etched into his mind. The bamboo forest is more a state of mind than an illusion. The move’s power is to free the Gu Immortal of all harmful restraints. The silver chains were one piece of the chess game in Imperfection Regret Pavilion. The move Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable left behind frees Duke Long from that effect.

Known users.text: Genesis Lotus Immortal Venerable (creator) Duke Long
